cars.headline: All-new, all-electric 2027 Highlander
cars.key_detail: Three-row electric SUV; Toyota states up to 320 miles manufacturer-estimated range on XLE AWD and Limited AWD with the 95.8-kWh battery.

cars.headline: Next-generation 2027 Silverado 1500
cars.key_detail: Redesigned full-size pickup with new 5.7L and 6.6L V8 engines, enhanced TurboMax, available Duramax diesel and a new digital cockpit.

cars.headline: All-new 2027 Kia EV3
cars.key_detail: Compact electric SUV with up to 321 miles of all-electric range on select FWD trims, native NACS charging and available AWD.

cars.headline: All-new 2027 Lexus TZ
cars.key_detail: Lexus' first three-row all-electric SUV, with up to a manufacturer-estimated 300 miles on select grades and standard DIRECT4 AWD.

cars.headline: Neue Klasse 2027 BMW iX3 50 xDrive
cars.powertrain: Battery electric AWD · U.S. launch Sep. 25, 2026
cars.key_detail: First series-production Neue Klasse BMW for the U.S., with up to 434 miles EPA-estimated range and up to 400 kW DC charging.

cars.headline: 2027 Toyota Tundra
cars.key_detail: Updated Tundra with Toyota's latest-generation Audio Multimedia system, Toyota Safety Sense 4.0 and an available Trailhunter package.

cars.headline: 2027 Toyota Sequoia
cars.key_detail: Updated three-row SUV with available Old Man Emu upgraded suspension, enhanced underbody protection and a built-in Drive Recorder Dashcam.

cars.headline: New 2027 Mercedes-Benz S-Class Sedan
cars.powertrain: Mild-hybrid gas / plug-in hybrid · Dealerships soon
cars.key_detail: Updated flagship sedan with new MB.OS technology, illuminated design elements, rear-axle steering and S 580e plug-in-hybrid availability.

cars.headline: New 2027 Mercedes-Benz EQS Sedan
cars.key_detail: Next-generation EQS with an 800-volt electrical architecture, up to 430 kW DC fast charging and a 122-kWh battery.

cars.headline: All-new 2027 Mercedes-Benz GLB SUV
cars.key_detail: Redesigned compact luxury SUV with available seating for seven, MB.OS, fourth-generation MBUX and a new M252 four-cylinder engine.
